rootCause.cause: The top-level schemaVersion field is not accepted by the installed Codex hooks parser.
SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit and Stop used legacy flat command entries instead of event groups containing typed command hooks.
The checker encoded the same legacy shape and invoked command fields directly, so it bypassed the client parser and produced a false green.

redControls: legacy flat SessionStart registration is rejected

independentScratchMutations.reason: top-level keys must be exactly hooks
